description: Lignes de transport en projet en Ile-de-France is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant les tracés des projets de transport en commun en Île-de-France. Un projet de ligne de transport est l'amélioration, le prolongement d'une ligne existante, ainsi que la création d'une nouvelle ligne de transport. En savoir plus sur les lignes en projet: Qualité Une ligne décrit le tracé du projet. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Lignes. Its keywords are Lignes, Projets, Chercheur ou journaliste, Collectivité. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
